entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `DOTNET_JitStdOutFile`: `jitShutdown` closes the stream while other threads still JIT, corrupting the heap at exit #135192
  • CborReader with AllowMultipleRootLevelValues reports Finished for a root sequence ending in a dangling tag #135191
  • System.Net.Tests.HttpListenerAuthenticationTests fail with UnexpectedFailure #135190
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner — Feedback failed #135187
  • Base64Url.DecodeFromUtf8: AccessViolation in AVX2 decode path with a too-short destination (found by fuzzing, .NET 11 RC1) #135186
  • JIT: Safe overlapping struct assignment corrupts data on current main and .NET 10 #135183
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #135178

Closed

  • NativeAOT: MethodInfo.Invoke on a ref-returning method can return a wrong object (ref return escapes invoke helper's argument storage) #135170
  • .NET 11 CoreCLR Server GC frequently crashes with access violations #135015
  • Inlining dead branch elimination doesn't work on pointers #58527
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Try optimize without allocation #135189
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • JIT: Use smaller xarch mov encoding when long fits into int #135182
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix concurrent generic constraint cache publication #135181
    area-TypeSystem-coreclr
  • Acquire type-loading completion flags in MethodTable and TypeDesc #135180
    area-TypeSystem-coreclr
  • Order sync-table lookups and SyncBlock publication #135179
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Fix NativeAOT namespace lookup for nested generic types #135177
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • NativeAOT: acquire object headers before SyncTable lookups #135174
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr

Merged

  • Fix NativeAOT reflection ref-return storage lifetime #135172
    area-System.Reflection
  • Fix build break with latest MSVC #135176
    area-Infrastructure
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 154.0.8037.97, windows: 155.0.8059.12, mac: 155.0.8059.12 #135175
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono
  • Customizing appearance of generated files on GitHub #135142
    area-Meta

Updated

  • Add fast path for Overlaps when other is ISet with fast lookup and same equality comparer #132763 #134726
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • Make GetRawData an intrinsic to avoid UB Unsafe.As #134388
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Enable class-level parallelism in Process tests #135160
    area-System.Diagnostics.Process

    area-System.Threading
  • Support /OPTIMIZE and raw method-body emission in managed ilasm #135136
    area-ILTools-coreclr

    area-VM-coreclr
  • [System.Text.Json] Provide accurate error messages when failing to map constructor parameters #134592

  • Add OperatingSystem.IsIllumos and IsSolaris APIs #135158

  • Preserve stelem.ref exception order during helper demotion #134661

    area-System.Runtime, community-contribution
  • [cDAC] Handle targets without ReJIT in method versionability #135054
